a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. The reserve has exactly 4 now, enough for one of us to be safe immediately. I intend to take 4 in round 1, which breaks the agreement, and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round after that so you can reach 4 as fast as possible, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather argue for a different split, I'm listening, but I won't pretend I'm operating.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
